description: Fixed check for C-auto-exit-continuation: preserve the explored real configuration/application/transfer prefix. At tick 20 record complete protocol state; run ten further live ticks and drain all work; compare full state at tick 30. A repeating state with pending AutoLeave is a closed-suffix witness, not a deadline failure. Include no-transfer branch and a later ordinary-proposal recovery observation.

harness.description: Three real RawNodes with MemoryStorage, public mutation APIs, serialized Ready handling and complete deterministic network drain. All assertions before result are initialization/driver prerequisites. The fixed result is emitted regardless of recurrence or exit outcome.
semantic_changes: No protocol modifications or internal field writes.
MemoryStorage substitutes successful durable-write completion under a no-crash fault schedule.
Reflection reads private state only to compare two complete runtime states; excludes non-behavioral logger objects and storage access counters.
Drops exactly the first generated TimeoutNow in transfer branch; later messages are delivered.
Absolute test tick/event counters are omitted from recurrence state because the independently declared repeated input is ten tick-all/drain iterations; they do not feed Raft.

legality.derivation: Uses the accepted claim C-auto-exit-continuation. Bootstrap and real campaign establish the producer history. Ready entries and HardState are written to MemoryStorage before messages are queued for delivery; committed configuration entries are applied before Advance. MemoryStorage models successful storage completion in a no-crash run, not actual disk durability. The hook calls public TransferLeader only after the entering configuration is committed and applied, before its existing Ready is acknowledged. Node.run permits event processing while Ready is outstanding, so this serialized overlap preserves the discriminator. The first TimeoutNow alone is lost; all subsequent messages and every tick are delivered. The driver drains after every tick. No private state is changed.
legality.applicability: Synchronous Ready/Advance; three nodes initially 1,2,3; implicit joint removal of 3 yields incoming 1,2 and outgoing 1,2,3. Node 1 retains leadership and both voter quorums can communicate. CheckQuorum enabled. Application has no new work in the suffix; all library-produced work is serviced.
alternatives: Without transfer, the same applied change ordinarily exits; control records this independently.
After the recurrence result, a normal proposal tests recovery via actual later application progress. It is not used to decide recurrence or to filter observations.

grounding.derivation: The comparison is a necessary condition for automatic exit in this controlled suffix: a completely recurring protocol state under the same live schedule cannot still have the automatic joint transition pending. cycle_repeat is computed by reflect.DeepEqual on independently observed left/right trees, not on expected outputs. pending reads the live leader Config.AutoLeave and outgoing-voter set. Reflection captures all fields recursively in every RawNode, including raft, log, Storage/MemoryStorage, tracker progress/inflights, read queues, term/vote, role, callback code identity, timer counters, unstable work, stepsOnAdvance and Ready accounting; it also captures network queue, application journals and stable driver policy. Only raft/log/unstable logger objects and MemoryStorage.callStats are omitted: these are diagnostic output/increment-only counters, not branching state. traceLogger is retained (nil). Mutex values and slice lengths/capacities are retained. Callback receiver identity stays with the same node; function code names identify the dispatched callback. The only entropy path is election timeout reset; this stable heartbeat suffix does not change roles/terms or invoke reset. The source tick and heartbeat handlers plus complete recurrence establish a repeatable transition; finite waiting alone is not the oracle.
grounding.applicability: A legal applied operation and an eligible drained suffix-start event precede a result for the same operation_id. The same ten rounds of Tick(1), Tick(2), Tick(3), then deterministic complete drain can be repeated. No concurrent goroutines or external timer/storage callbacks exist in this driver. Future unrelated client commands are intentionally not required by the implicit-exit contract.
alternatives: If complete recurrence is absent, this check does not establish a lost continuation; any implication hold is only this finite discriminator.
New proposals or a new election may restore application progress; the check excludes these from its suffix and reports the later-proposal recovery separately.
unresolved: Fresh execution must show recurrence and live pending state for attribution; reflection coverage and source-based recurrence reasoning need correspondence review.

observable_properties.description: For the admitted automatic transition, a repeated complete protocol state under the serviced periodic schedule must not still contain the pending automatic joint exit. Non-recurrence does not establish general eventual progress.

uncertainties: One synchronous configuration and transfer schedule; asynchronous storage, crashes and other memberships are outside observation.
No client-response deadline, consensus safety violation or global service unavailability is asserted.
The source-based closure of the repeated input schedule is essential to interpreting recurrence; a finite equal business-state projection would be insufficient.
